irregularities.title: 122 player(s) have no official designation but do have an ESPN status
irregularities.detail: nfl.com printed a blank Game Status for these players (they practised without a designation), so this site renders them as ACTIVE and marks the designation as inferred. ESPN separately carries a news-derived status. This is a semantic difference between the two sources, NOT a data error, so it is reported once in aggregate rather than once per player.

irregularities.title: Roster index pruned 5 record(s) no current source supports
irregularities.detail: The player index is pruned each run: a (club, player) record is dropped when the official report names the player under a different club and no current source still asserts it, or when no source has asserted it for 14 days. Dropped this run: DAL:luke-schoonmaker (not asserted by any source for 14.0 days); DAL:justin-barron (not asserted by any source for 14.0 days); TB:payne-durham (not asserted by any source for 14.0 days); DAL:reddy-steward (not asserted by any source for 14.0 days); DAL:tyler-booker (not asserted by any source for 14.0 days). This is the guard against stale records mis-attributing in-game events (see the 2026-09-16 HOU/GB misattribution in the README verification log).

irregularities.title: 45 reporter claim(s) contradicted by the official report
irregularities.detail: These claims are retained (not deleted) because a contradicted claim is the evidence that drives a reporter's score down. Examples: NBC Sports said QUESTIONABLE for Christian Gonzalez (official: see link); CBS Sports said QUESTIONABLE for Christian Gonzalez (official: see link); NBC Sports said QUESTIONABLE for Christian Gonzalez (official: see link); rapsheet.bsky.social said QUESTIONABLE for Christian Gonzalez (official: see link); OregonLive.com said ACTIVE for Nick Bosa (official: see link)

irregularities.title: Beat writer Aaron Wilson is attributed across 2 clubs (HOU, LAR)
irregularities.detail: ESPN printed Aaron Wilson (KPRC 2 Houston) as the attribution on updates for multiple clubs. Local beat writers normally cover one club, so this is usually a shared-wire/aggregator attribution; it is kept as observed and flagged for manual review rather than reassigned by guesswork.

irregularities.title: Longest gap between collector runs is 3575 minutes
irregularities.detail: The workflow is scheduled every 5 minutes, but GitHub throttles and queues scheduled workflows, so this is the cadence the collector actually achieved over the archived runs. Alerts can only be as timely as this number: see the cadence panel on the site, which is fed from the same measurement.
